author: birdybro (GitHub; MiSTer contributor)
what_it_is: birdybro's MiSTer FDS save of Akumajou Dracula (2-sided disk), posted 2024-05-07; file dated 2024-05-07.
note: MiSTer NES core FDS save: 16 zero bytes, then the whole disk image as the core holds it (each side 65500 bytes, fwNES layout without the 16-byte 'FDS\x1a' header), then padding to a 512-byte multiple (2 sides: 16 + 131000 + 56 = 131072). The disk sides start at offset 0x10. Matches NES.sv: save_sz = rom_sz[17:9] sectors read from SDRAM 0x3C0000, disk loaded at 0x3C0010. Bytes 0x10.. equal the No-Intro image except 1 byte (side A offset 0x39). Checked against the No-Intro image (work/fds/fdscheck.py): every disk file is identical to the original, so this file holds no in-game save (the TOUROKU0 name file is untouched); it is kept as a sample of the MiSTer FDS container, not of a game save.
